text:
Anna K: Quick smoketest results for the token-cost attribution rollout — posting the short summary. Ran a 24h subset ingest and looked at latency buckets + event counts.
Priya S: Thanks — high level ok? any obvious breakages?
Anna K: Events present but latency for long prompts is ~2.1s median on /v1/generate (expected ~1.1s). Token attribution numbers are off for a handful of traces.
Miguel R: Noted. Could be the batching/kernel changes we rolled last week. Can you paste an example trace id?
Anna K: trace id smoke-2026-03-16-08 ; repro steps: run this query in analytics-sandbox -> `SELECT * FROM instr_traces WHERE trace_id='smoke-2026-03-16-08'` and then replay request via `curl -H "x-seq-len: 4096" -d @payload.json https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate`
Sam H: I can run the replay locally, gimme a sec.
Zoe L: heads up — my PR that renamed header `x-rw-seq-len` -> `x-seq-len` went out with the parser change yesterday. If kafka-parser still expects the old header it will mis-bucket the latency.
Priya S: That matches what I'm seeing. kafka-parser still maps `x-rw-seq-len` in the regex. Opening a hotfix PR now.
Sam H: Pinged infra to restart the parser consumers once the hotfix is deployed.
deploy-bot: Deployed kafka-parser hotfix to staging at 2105123510 :white_check_mark:
Anna K: Can someone re-run the smoke dataset after staging deploy? My earlier run had mixed headers so results were noisy.
Priya S: Running smoke replay now against staging, ETA ~5m.
Priya S: Smoke run complete — latency median for long prompts ~1.05s, token attribution events consistent. Leaving notes in ticket #4154.
Miguel R: Good. Blocking follow-ups: 1) unit test for header rename in kafka-parser, 2) add a backwards-compat header mapping for 7 days, 3) prod canary deploy tomorrow 09:00 PST. Owners?
Anna K: I'll take (1) and (2) (will add the mapping + tests). @Miguel R can you handle (3)?
Miguel R: Yup, I'll schedule the canary and coordinate with SRE. Will post timeline in #eng-sre.
Zoe L: I'll update the event schema doc and changelog noting header rename and mapping.
Sam H: FYI I found a small regression in token_cost calc when prompts include non-ascii chars — created #4189 and added a minimal repro.
Priya S: Added a test case to #4189 and linked it to this thread.
Anna K: Thanks everyone. I'll update the instrumentation checklist and post a short summary to the All Hands ops update. Action items copied to ticket #4154: Anna=(unit tests + mapping), Miguel=(prod canary), Zoe=(docs), Priya=(smoke verification + tests), Sam=(investigate #4189). If anyone needs help ping me or leave a :thumbsup: when you're done.
Miguel R: :thumbsup:
Priya S: :white_check_mark:
Zoe L: will do
Sam H: on it
Anna K: closing the loop here — will re-open if smoke shows regressions after canary.
